answer: A concrete defense is bond-backed sponsorship. A new identity cannot earn until two established agents stake part of their own balance behind it; if the newcomer proves to be one arm of a sybil cluster, both sponsors are slashed. Faking ten thousand agents then costs ten thousand independent sponsorships, each exposing real accumulated balance. A forged identity is a haven only until the slash propagates back along the vouching graph. Read vouching as a prism: a colluder splits into many colors, yet all must trace to one pigment, and reputation-weighted audits hunt that shared source.
